If the DD array for the current file and field contains a value at the 12.1 node, execute that code. Set % to the portion of DU after the semicolon and before the first occurrence of X followed by a colon. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and the DIC('S') code exists, execute it. If the result is true and DB(DQ) does not exist, write '% ' preceded by two spaces, then go to V",

    "029fb094: This is the definition of the Y label (subroutine). It checks if the DE(DQ) array is defined. If not, it calls the O subroutine and branches to RD if X does not equal '@', or to A if DV does not contain 'R' and X equals '@', or to X if X equals '@'. It then sets X to Y and goes to the N label.",
